The information provided here was last updated in May 2024. Important Note on Usage of This Information: This document serves as a summary and does not include all possible details about the product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive guidance regarding this product and your individual health requirements. This medication has been prescribed solely for your current condition. Laboratory tests, such as kidney function assessments, complete blood counts, blood sugar levels, or cultures, may be conducted before starting this medication and periodically during its use. Missed Dose Instructions: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Storage Guidelines: Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless directed to do so. Properly dispose of this product when it is expired or no longer required. Final Reminder: This document is a summary and does not contain all possible information about the product. Always seek advice from your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
